name: SKAdNetwork and AdAttributionKit
plain: Apple's privacy preserving attribution: ad networks learn campaign results from a delayed, noisy postback.
meaning: Replaces device level tracking with coarse conversion values after a 0 to 2, 3 to 7 or 8 to 35 day window. AdAttributionKit (iOS 17.4) extends it to alternative stores and re-engagement.

android.note: Android uses Install Referrer and the Privacy Sandbox Attribution Reporting API

ios.persistence: Postbacks arrive 24 to 48 h after a window closes; up to three postbacks per install in SKAN 4
ios.note: Windows 0 to 2, 3 to 7 and 8 to 35 days; privacy thresholds can yield nil values (docs, from memory)

limits.headline: Can tell an ad network an ad led to an install, in a delayed report
limits.user_action: You tap an ad, install the app, then use it for a few days
can: Send a coarse result after a window of 0 to 2, 3 to 7 or 8 to 35 days
Cover alternative app stores and re-engagement with AdAttributionKit (iOS 17.4)
Pass a small score about what you did
cannot: Give your name or device ID
Report detail when too few people installed; the result can be empty
Work on Android; it uses the install referrer
limits.differs: iPhone only (iOS 11.3 and later). Android uses the install referrer.

story.what_it_is: Apple's private ad measurement system, with delayed and noisy reports, and its newer version.

marketing.name: SKAdNetwork and AdAttributionKit
marketing.pitch: Measure ad conversions while protecting user privacy.

story.for_you: You never see it. Apple reports to the ad network that an install happened, days later, in a form that cannot point at you.
story.for_makers: After 0 to 2, 3 to 7 and 8 to 35 day windows, networks get coarse values. AdAttributionKit from iOS 17.4 extends this to re-engagement and alternative marketplaces.

use_cases.example: A studio measures which ad network brought paying players after a week.
A fashion app learns which video ad brought installs and a first order.
An ad network proves the install with a signed postback.
A growth team joins SKAN data with its own sales to estimate the gap.
A social app learns which campaigns brought sign ups.

story.ios_note: Replaced device level tracking for people who decline ATT.
